text: {"us_status":"written","label_product":"YESCARTA (axicabtagene ciloleucel) suspension for intravenous infusion","label_version_or_date":"DailyMed current version 23; published 2026-08-17; label Revised: 8/2026; DailyMed updated 2026-08-06","label_section":"Warnings and Precautions (5.2 Neurologic Toxicities)","quote":"Cerebral edema occurred at a higher frequency in patients with primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma (PMBCL).","eu":"EU: PRAC Apr 2026 recommended the Yescarta PI update; current EMA SmPC adds cerebral oedema as uncommon and states risk may be higher in PMBCL patients.","uk":"UK: MHRA/UK product information for Yescarta is marketed; UK SmPC text likewise states risk for cerebral oedema may be higher in PMBCL patients and lists cerebral oedema as uncommon.","us_regulator":"FDA: public action found—2026-08-06 supplement approval letter BL 125643/802 approved revisions to Sections 5 and 6 for increased cerebral edema risk in PMBCL; no separate FAERS potential-signal or Sentinel study located.","sources":["https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/drugInfo.cfm?lang=en&setid=9b70606e-b99c-4272-a0f1-b5523cce0c59","https://www.fda.gov/media/194133/download?attachment=","https://www.fda.gov/vaccines-blood-biologics/cellular-gene-therapy-products/yescarta","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/prac-recommendation/new-product-information-wording-extracts-prac-recommendations-signals-adopted-7-10-april-2026-prac_en.pdf","https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/product-information/yescarta-epar-product-information_en.pdf","https://products.mhra.gov.uk/substance/?substance=AXICABTAGENE+CILOLEUCEL","https://www.medicines.org.uk/emc/product/9439/smpc"]}
